verdict.rationale: Skyvern is a browser-automation platform, not an analytics product. Its in-product AI is aimed at automation, not at analysing user data. The closest matches are a Copilot chat that helps build and debug workflows interactively, AI extraction of structured data from pages, and captured AI reasoning for each run. missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis over the user's own data, proactive suggestions derived from run or extracted data, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
